notes: High level: enterprise legal discovery + compliance monitoring platform. Heavy emphasis on immutable audit trails and retention for regulatory e-discovery (7 years requested).

Workload profile: nightly bulk ingestion of ~250M doc fragments (OCR + text), incremental daily delta ~1.5M docs. Typical query pattern: interactive lawyer search (low latency, P99 target 200ms across reranking stack) + scheduled batch rerank jobs for custodian lists.
Embeddings strategy: client prefers hybrid approach — sparse indexing for recall + dense embeddings for rerank. Initial PoC to validate faiss/HNSW vs managed vector DB latency under VPC constraints.

Reranking: cross-encoder supervised reranker in front of dense retrieval; want deterministic fallback to smaller model for cold starts. P99 SLA target for end-to-end query (retrieve+rerank) = 200ms; acceptable average = 80-120ms. Cost sensitivity: target avg cost per interactive query <= $0.03/token-equivalent (customer expects quantization/optimize guidance).
Indexing scale concerns: planning 400–600M vectors; storage/replication and snapshot cadence need to be documented. Asked for recommended shard sizing and estimated monthly egress/storage costs.

Security & compliance: must support VPC private deployment (no egress to public internet), customer-managed KMS/HSM, detailed audit logs that are immutable and exportable to Splunk. Data residency: primary in us-east-1; backups to dedicated customer account. Retention controls: legal hold API required.

Quotes from stakeholders: CIO - 'We need provable chain-of-custody for any doc surfaced in litigation.' Lead search engineer - 'Latency + cost tradeoffs decide whether we run heavy cross-encoder per query or batch rerank overnight.'

PoC scope agreed 10/15: ingest 5M doc set (mixed PDFs, DOCX, OCR), index with hybrid pipeline, run interactive queries (1000 synthetic lawyer queries), measure P50/P95/P99 and cost per query. Success criteria: P99 < 300ms baseline, recall@20 > 0.85 vs current TF-IDF baseline, audit log events for every query and index change verified in SIEM.

Security questionnaire: answered v1 on 2025-09-08; follow-up items: CMK integration details, data-at-rest diagrams, TLS cert rotation process. Requests copy of SOC2 Type II (they flagged SOC2 + ISO27001).
Procurement notes: prefer 12–24 month term, negotiation on data egress and overage billing, interested in reserved Dedicated pool if latency targets require it.

requirements_summary: Private/VPC deployment with no public egress for content index or embeddings
CMK/HSM support and customer key rotation, KMS audit logs accessible
End-to-end audit logging for every query, index change, and user action; immutable export to Splunk/SIEM
Retention controls + legal hold API for 7+ years; immutable snapshots for e-discovery
Hybrid retrieval: sparse inverted index + dense vector store; ability to run cross-encoder reranker (GPU) with canary fallback to quantized smaller model

Latency SLOs: P50 < 100ms, P95 < 180ms, P99 < 300ms end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) for interactive queries
Cost target: average per-interactive-query cost <= $0.03 (considering quantized model & batching recommendations)
Operational: per-route token/call cost breakdown, tracing hooks, and per-user usage audit
